name: Iyarashi Kurashi ~Relief Doll~
source: This is a communication game where an android takes care of a lonely heroine and helps to heal her both physically and emotionally. The game includes conversations, cuddles, head pats, bath time, and even intimate moments in bed, all while fulfilling the heroine's requests and providing relief from the stresses of living alone as a working adult.
translation: 这是一款交流游戏，由仿生人照料孤独的女主人公，抚慰她的身心。游戏包含交谈、拥抱、摸头、共浴，乃至床笫间的亲密时刻。你将满足女主人公的种种请求，缓解她身为独居上班族的生活压力。
